_meta.description: Reference business profile for NVDA eval grounding checks. Extraction must hit these facts.

reference_profile.what_they_do: NVIDIA designs GPUs and accelerated computing platforms for AI training, inference, scientific computing, gaming, and automotive applications. Revenue is dominated by Data Center (Hopper/Blackwell GPU clusters sold to hyperscalers and enterprises) with Gaming as the second segment.
reference_profile.moat: CUDA software ecosystem with 4M+ developers and 3500+ GPU-accelerated applications creates extreme switching costs. Customers rebuild entire MLOps stacks on NVIDIA primitives.
top_risks: Custom silicon from hyperscalers (Google TPU, AWS Trainium, Microsoft Maia) could reduce GPU purchases
AMD MI300X gaining traction in inference workloads
US export controls on China, representing ~10-15% of historical revenue
TSMC concentration risk for advanced node supply
Blackwell yield and ramp execution risk
